[[File:UtilityDroids-SGtD.jpg|thumb|right|250px|An [[Astromech droid/Legends|astromech droid]] and a [[T3-series utility droid]]]]
{{Quote|That barve got drilled a coupla months ago. Right outside the door. I had a pair of rehab droids scrubbing the burn mark for two whole standard time periods, and it still didn't come out.|Wuher|<ref name="The Mandalorian Armor">''[[The Mandalorian Armor]]''</ref>}}
'''Cleaning droids''', also known as '''utility droids''' or '''janitor droids''',<ref name="OE">[[Operation: Elrood (book)|''Operation: Elrood'']]</ref> were the predecessors of [[Astromech droid/Legends|astromech droids]] used around the time of the [[Jedi Civil War]]. These small [[Droid/Legends|droids]] were widespread during their prime. Almost all were under one meter tall. They were equipped either with wheeled legs or small [[Repulsorlift/Legends|repulsorlift]] generators for movement.<ref name="KOTOR">''[[Star Wars: Knights of the Old Republic]]''</ref>

[[Wuher/Legends|Wuher]] assigned a pair of rehab droids to clean up the scorch mark on the outside of the [[Chalmun's Spaceport Cantina/Legends|cantina]] left over from the death of [[Codeq Santhananan]].<ref name="The Mandalorian Armor" />

The term "utility droid" was used for many different models that varied widely in form and function. Some of them, particularly the [[Duwani Mechanical Products/Legends|Duwani Mechanicals]] models, were at times referred as "astromech droids." Some models were used for advanced applied physics functions such as [[Starship/Legends|starship]] repair, [[Astrogation/Legends|astrogation]], and even computer [[Slicer/Legends|slicing]] and programming. Others performed more menial tasks such as janitorial duties and waste disposal.<ref name="KOTOR" />
